allow_instructions: Allow no-mistakes commands for documented repository checks.
Allow pr-shepherd commands when the user explicitly requests PR review or iteration.
block_instructions: Every git push --force or git push -f without --force-with-lease requires approval first.
Every git commit --amend requires approval first.
Every command that bypasses git hooks with SKIP_PREPUSH, HUSKY=0, or --no-verify requires approval first.
Every sudo command requires approval first.
